stack.label: The ten rapiers that weighed as one
stack.explanation: A stack of ten rapiers in the pack, weighed by the home-value maths. The Borg multiplied the weapon weight by the stack size, so ten 4-pound rapiers were treated as one 40-pound sword: the Borg computed 1 blow where the engine gives 2 per weapon. The correction weighs one weapon, like the engine: 2 equals 2.
